learning_outcomes.text: Will be able to interpret the repercussions of the legal, economic, and social framework on business decisions.
Will be able to plan the long-term activities of the company.
Will be able to design a basic strategic plan.
Will know the basic functional areas of the company.
Will be able to select investments and sources of financing for business projects.
Will be able to search for and interpret available economic information in the company.

assessment_rules: The assessment system states that 40% of the grade is obtained through continuous assessment, which includes the defense of works and reports carried out during class sessions. Class attendance is mandatory; non-attendance implies the inability to be evaluated in the corresponding activity. To average the exam grade with continuous assessment, at least 50% of the exam must be passed. If this requirement is not met, the final grade for the course will be FAIL, capped at a maximum of 4.5 points based on the weighted average of continuous assessment activities. For part-time students, non-recoverable assessment activities will be replaced by equivalent ones.
